Used when asking for clarification or changing the subject.
Used to explain the reason for something just mentioned.
words.meaning_vi: Đó là lý do vì sao

words.def_en: A kind, sweet, or helpful person (also a term of affection).
Used to promise that a mistake will not be repeated.
words.meaning_vi: Chuyện đó sẽ không tái diễn nữa

To lose your job because the company reduces its number of employees.
To be told to leave your job, usually because of poor performance.
To be given a more important job or position.
To formally announce that you are leaving your job.
To stop working permanently, usually because of age.

To start a new business or organization.
To attend a course in order to learn new skills.
To work extra hours beyond normal / to work at set alternating times (day, night...).
Working for different companies rather than being employed by just one.
Working only a few hours a day or week (opp. full-time).
Working for yourself rather than for an employer.

words.def_en: Lasting only a limited time, e.g., a short contract (opp. permanent).
Without a job.
Working the whole/standard number of hours / lasting indefinitely.
words.meaning_vi: Toàn thời gian / cố định lâu dài

words.def_en: Responsible for controlling or managing something.
Having control and authority over something; being the cause of it.
A document listing your education and work experience, sent to apply for a job.
Official records showing you have completed training or passed exams.
A container you carry to hold items while shopping.
A large container on wheels for shopping (BrE: trolley).
A card to pay later (credit) / a card that takes money directly from your bank account (debit).
words.meaning_vi: Thẻ tín dụng / thẻ ghi nợ

words.def_en: A piece of paper showing that you have paid for something.
Money given back to you when you return an item.
A reduction in the usual price / something bought for less than its usual value.
One of several stores owned by the same company / a large store with many sections.
words.meaning_vi: Cửa hàng chuỗi / cửa hàng bách hóa

words.def_en: To put on clothing to see if it fits or suits you.
A room in a store where customers try on clothes.
To be the right size for you / to look good on you.
A person whose job is to sell things in a store.
Help and assistance provided to people who buy goods or services.
words.meaning_vi: Dịch vụ chăm sóc khách hàng

words.def_en: To spread very quickly to many people, especially online.
Something successfully accomplished.
A statement that something is unsatisfactory or unacceptable.
Money paid to make up for loss, damage, or injury.
An amount of money paid for something.
Something that happens to a person by chance, good or bad.
Having good things happen to you by chance.
Having bad things happen to you by chance.
Used to say that something good happened by chance.
Used to say that something bad happened by chance.
Chance, considered as a force that affects people's lives.
Lucky.
Unlucky.
Luckily.
Unluckily, sadly.
words.meaning_vi: Đáng tiếc là, không may là

words.def_en: A pleasant feeling of being physically relaxed and free from pain.
Making you feel physically relaxed.
Not comfortable; causing physical or mental unease.
In a comfortable way.
In an uncomfortable way.
The ability to stay calm and wait for a long time or accept difficulty.
Able to stay calm and wait for a long time.
Not patient; easily annoyed by delay or problems.
In a patient way.
In an impatient way.
Serious attention, or the process of looking after someone.
Giving serious attention to what you are doing, to avoid harm or mistakes.
Not giving enough attention to what you are doing; making mistakes.
In a careful way.
In a careless way.
A device that connects electrical equipment, allowing a plug from one country to be used in another.
A device for putting electrical power back into a battery.
A small portable device for storing and moving computer data.
The set of keys on a computer that you press to type.
A small device that you move to control what happens on a computer screen.
A place in a wall where you plug in electrical equipment (BrE: socket).
A device with metal pins that connects electrical equipment to an outlet.
A machine that prints documents from a computer.
A device used to operate a television or other equipment from a distance.
A device that sends data between computer networks, e.g., for a Wi-Fi connection.
A device that produces sound from an electronic device.
A small device for turning an electrical device on or off.
A cable used to connect a device to a computer or charger.
To turn a device on / off.
To connect / disconnect a device from a power supply.
To increase / decrease the volume, heat, etc.
words.meaning_vi: Vặn to lên / vặn nhỏ đi

words.def_en: To put software or an app onto a computer or device.
To install the newest version of software or an app.
To adjust a device so it will work at a particular time or level.
To remove text, data, or a file from a computer or device.
To find a solution to a problem or disagreement.
To make someone believe that something is true.
To say firmly that something is true or must be done.
Making you feel ashamed or shy.
Easy to see or understand; clear.
To ask someone to marry you.
A question phrased more politely, often beginning with a phrase like "Could you tell me...?"
A ticket for a trip to a place but not back again.
A reduction in the usual price of something.
Food bought at a restaurant to eat somewhere else (BrE: takeaway).
To open your mouth wide and breathe in deeply, usually when tired or bored.
A device at the entrance of a building that makes a sound to let someone in.
words.meaning_vi: Chuông cửa (bấm chuông vào tòa nhà)

words.def_en: Used to point out something that is clear or easy to see.
Used to suggest a possibility or ask about a hypothetical situation.
Used to tell someone to stop doing something, often teasing you.

words.term: Why is Paul in your apartment?
words.meaning_vi: Could you tell me why Paul is still in your apartment?
Do you know if (hoặc whether) he's got one now?
I'd like to know what you really want.

words.term: Do you really want to be here?
words.meaning_vi: I wonder if (hoặc whether) you really want to be here.

words.term: What did you decide at the last meeting?
words.meaning_vi: Can you tell me what you decided at the last meeting?

words.def_en: A
That girl really looks like your sister.
Did you say she was American?
words.meaning_vi: No, I said she was Canadian.

words.def_en: Is the shoe store the one after the traffic lights?
words.meaning_vi: No, it's the one before the traffic lights.

words.def_en: Should we get her this bag then?
words.meaning_vi: Personally, I still think she'd prefer that one.

words.def_en: I thought you said you read the book?
words.meaning_vi: I bought it, but I haven't read it yet.

words.def_en: I left your briefcase on your bed.
words.meaning_vi: Could you put it under my bed, please?

words.def_en: Is that your dog?
words.meaning_vi: He's not my dog. He's my girlfriend's / boyfriend's dog.

words.def_en: Here you are. A tuna sandwich and a cola.
words.meaning_vi: Sorry, I asked for a tuna salad.

words.def_en: Did you lend John the money he needed to buy the car?
words.meaning_vi: I gave him the money. He'd never be able to pay me back.

words.def_en: That coat looks really expensive.
words.meaning_vi: It looks expensive, but actually it was really cheap.

words.def_en: You're not going out tonight, are you?
words.meaning_vi: I am going out. I haven't been out for a long time.

words.def_en: Chicago won 2-1 on Saturday.
Câu hỏi / phát biểu
Have you ever been to Canada?
words.meaning_vi: A. He is! He made the varsity team this year.

words.def_en: I absolutely hate getting up early.
words.meaning_vi: B. I don't, but my sister does. I'm too lazy!

words.def_en: Is Lina coming swimming this afternoon?
words.meaning_vi: C. No, there weren't. Where were you, by the way?

words.def_en: Your brother lives in San Diego, doesn't he?
words.meaning_vi: D. She said she wanted to, but she wasn't sure if she'd be able to.

words.def_en: You do like cabbage, don't you?

words.def_en: Are you going to go skiing during winter break?
words.meaning_vi: F. I love it. It's cauliflower I can't stand.

words.def_en: Were there many people in class yesterday?
words.meaning_vi: G. No, but I'd love to if I ever got the chance.

words.def_en: Do you do a lot of gardening?
words.meaning_vi: H. She isn't but her children are. She didn't want to.

words.def_en: Erica did say she was coming, didn't she?
words.meaning_vi: I. So do I. Luckily I don't often have to.

words.def_en: Adam isn't particularly good at tennis, is he?
words.meaning_vi: J. Yes, and so does my sister.

Where a race begins / ends.

words.meaning_vi: What I don't like here is the weather.
All I want is to travel.
All I did was touch it.

words.meaning_vi: What happens is (that) you take a test and then you have an interview.

words.term: We left our passports at home.
words.meaning_vi: What happened was (that) we left our passports at home.
The person (who / that) I spoke to was the manager.

words.meaning_vi: The place where we stayed was a five-star hotel.

words.term: I last saw him on Saturday.
words.meaning_vi: The last time I saw him was on Saturday.

words.meaning_vi: The reason (why / that) I bought it was that / because it was cheap.

words.meaning_vi: It was a boy in my class who won the prize.

words.meaning_vi: It was last Friday when we had the meeting.

words.meaning_vi: It was the bread (that) they charged us extra for.

words.def_en: Ví dụ

words.level: Khác biệt LỚN much · a lot · far
words.def_en: The play was much better than I'd expected. He's driving a lot more carefully since he got points on his license. The Hawaiian coffee is far more expensive than the Colombian one.
words.meaning_vi: + tính từ/trạng từ so sánh hơn.

words.def_en: She earns much more money than I do. Women today have many more opportunities than they used to.
words.meaning_vi: ⚠️ much / far / a lot more + danh từ không đếm được many / far / a lot more + danh từ đếm được số nhiều

words.level: Khác biệt NHỎ slightly · a little · a bit
words.def_en: She's a little better than she was yesterday. The later train is slightly cheaper than the earlier one. Could you two talk a bit more quietly, please?
A: Would you like some more coffee? B: Just a little more, please. We only have a few more minutes before the show starts.
words.meaning_vi: ⚠️ a little / slightly / a little bit more + không đếm được a few / slightly more + đếm được số nhiều

words.def_en: The taxi driver drove faster and faster. It's getting more and more difficult to make ends meet nowadays.
words.meaning_vi: ⚠️ Với so sánh dùng more, tính từ chỉ đặt sau more thứ hai: ❌ more difficult and more difficult

words.def_en: Ví dụ
It was freezing cold, so I wore a thick coat.
words.meaning_vi: Cách phổ biến nhất, thân mật. "nên, vì vậy". Nối trong cùng một câu.

words.def_en: It snowed hard all night. As a result, the airport was closed the following morning.
words.meaning_vi: Đứng đầu câu/mệnh đề, theo sau là dấu phẩy. "Kết quả là," ⚠️ Khi từ nối mở đầu một mệnh đề thì nó thường đứng SAU dấu phẩy, hoặc dấu phẩy + and: …qualifications, and therefore we are unable to offer you the job.

words.def_en: We regret that you do not have the necessary qualifications, and therefore / consequently we are unable to offer you the job.
words.meaning_vi: Trang trọng hơn so. "do đó, vì thế". Có thể đứng đầu mệnh đề, hoặc trước động từ chính: We have therefore decided not to offer you the job.

words.def_en: I have stopped writing to her because / as / since she never answers me.
words.meaning_vi: Đồng nghĩa, đều "vì, bởi vì". As trang trọng hơn và hay đứng đầu câu: As the weather is so awful, we've decided not to go out. → theo sau là MỆNH ĐỀ (S + V).

words.def_en: The plane was late because of the fog.
words.meaning_vi: Theo sau là DANH TỪ, không phải mệnh đề. "vì, do"

words.def_en: Flight 341 has been delayed due to / owing to adverse weather conditions.
words.meaning_vi: Cũng theo sau là DANH TỪ. Trang trọng hơn because of — hay gặp trong thông báo sân bay, văn bản công ty.

words.term: to in order to so as to
words.def_en: I took a language course to / in order to / so as to improve my English.
words.meaning_vi: Đều theo sau là động từ nguyên mẫu. "để, nhằm". So as to và in order to trang trọng hơn to.

words.term: so as not to in order not to
words.def_en: She closed the door quietly so as not to / in order not to wake the baby.
words.meaning_vi: Dạng phủ định. Bắt buộc dùng dạng này: ❌ She closed the door quietly not to wake the baby.

words.def_en: They moved to Quito so (that) they could see their grandchildren more often.
words.meaning_vi: Có thể bỏ that khi nói/viết thân mật. BẮT BUỘC dùng so that khi đổi chủ ngữ: She put a blanket over the baby so (that) he wouldn't be cold.

words.def_en: I'm not going to tell Ann in case she tells everyone else.
words.meaning_vi: "phòng khi, đề phòng" — làm gì đó để sẵn sàng cho hoặc tránh tình huống tương lai.

words.def_en: We enjoyed the concert, but we didn't have very good seats.
words.meaning_vi: Phổ biến nhất, thân mật. Nối hai ý trong cùng một câu.

words.def_en: Agnes was attracted to the stranger, yet something in her head was telling her not to get close to him.
words.meaning_vi: Dùng y hệt but nhưng trang trọng / văn chương hơn.

words.def_en: We enjoyed the concert. However, we didn't have very good seats.
words.meaning_vi: Đứng đầu câu, nối với câu trước, theo sau là dấu phẩy. Nevertheless (hoặc nonetheless) trang trọng/văn chương hơn however.

words.def_en: We enjoyed the concert although / even though / though we didn't have very good seats.
words.meaning_vi: Theo sau là MỆNH ĐỀ. Even though nhấn mạnh hơn although; though thông dụng hơn trong văn nói thân mật.

words.def_en: He's very friendly — a little stingy, though.
words.meaning_vi: Đặt cuối câu như một trạng từ bình luận. "…mà thôi / có điều là…"

words.def_en: In spite of being attracted to the stranger, … Despite her attraction to the stranger, … Despite the fact that she was attracted to the stranger, …
words.meaning_vi: Theo sau bắt buộc là V-ing, danh từ, hoặc the fact that + mệnh đề. ❌ despite of — despite KHÔNG có of!

words.def_en: Ví dụ
words.meaning_vi: Quy tắc & giải thích tiếng Việt

words.def_en: They have a large, rather dilapidated house in Florida.
words.meaning_vi: Sở hữu. Đây là động từ tĩnh (stative) → KHÔNG chia tiếp diễn. Nghi vấn/phủ định dùng do / did. ❌ They are having a house in Florida.

words.def_en: He doesn't have lunch at home. Are you having lunch?
words.meaning_vi: have + tân ngữ = hành động (have a snack / a drink / a meal / a shower / a party…). Đây là động từ động (dynamic) → CHIA tiếp diễn được.

words.def_en: They've been married for 15 years. How long has Anna been going out with James?
words.meaning_vi: Trợ động từ tạo thì hiện tại hoàn thành (đơn & tiếp diễn). Nghi vấn: đảo have lên trước chủ ngữ. Phủ định: haven't / hasn't. Cũng dùng cho tương lai hoàn thành, perfect infinitive…

words.def_en: We're going to have the kitchen repainted next week. I had my eyes examined when I got my new glasses.
words.meaning_vi: have + tân ngữ + quá khứ phân từ = nhờ/thuê người khác làm giúp (thể sai khiến). get là cách nói tự nhiên hơn: Where do you get your hair cut?

words.def_en: He's got a lot to learn about raising children.
words.meaning_vi: have got = have (sở hữu), chỉ dùng trong văn nói thân mật, nghĩa y hệt. Ở đây have là trợ động từ → nghi vấn đảo have, phủ định haven't/hasn't. ⚠️ Have got chỉ có nghĩa hiện tại. Quá khứ phải dùng had: ❌ had got

words.def_en: Ví dụ
words.meaning_vi: Quy tắc & giải thích tiếng Việt

words.def_en: You can learn a language faster if you go to live in a country where it is spoken.
words.meaning_vi: Dùng you để nói người ta nói chung, không phải "bạn". Đây là cách thông dụng nhất.

words.def_en: One should never criticize without being sure of the facts.
words.meaning_vi: one + động từ chia ngôi thứ ba số ít. Trang trọng hơn you và rất hiếm dùng trong văn nói.

words.def_en: When we talk about an accent, we must not confuse this with pronunciation.
words.meaning_vi: Dùng khi muốn bao gồm cả người đọc/người nghe vào phát biểu chung.

words.def_en: They always say that it's never too late to learn a new language. They should make it a requirement for people to learn two foreign languages at school.
words.meaning_vi: Văn thân mật. They = "người ta" (câu 1) hoặc giới có thẩm quyền — chính phủ, nhà trường… (câu 2).

words.def_en: If someone goes to live in a foreign country, they will have to get used to a different way of life. Could the person who left their bag in the library please come and see me?
words.meaning_vi: Dùng they/them/their cho một người chưa rõ nam hay nữ, thay vì he or she / his or her. Đây là chuẩn hiện đại, rất thông dụng.

words.def_en: Ví dụ
words.meaning_vi: Quy tắc & giải thích tiếng Việt

words.def_en: You need to take care of yourself with that cold. He's very egocentric. He always talks about himself.
words.meaning_vi: Dùng đại từ phản thân khi chủ ngữ và tân ngữ là cùng một người. ⚠️ KHÔNG dùng với wash, shave, feel, relax, concentrate: ❌ relax yourself → ✅ relax

words.def_en: I managed to complete the crossword! I was really proud of myself.
words.meaning_vi: Dùng sau hầu hết các giới từ khi bổ ngữ trùng chủ ngữ. ⚠️ Nhưng sau giới từ chỉ nơi chốn thì dùng đại từ tân ngữ: She put the bag next to her on the seat. ❌ next to herself

words.def_en: We decorated the house ourselves. There's no way I'm going to do it for you. Do it yourself!
words.meaning_vi: Dùng để nhấn mạnh chủ ngữ: chính chúng tôi làm, chứ không thuê thợ.

words.def_en: I don't feel very comfortable going to the movies by myself.
words.meaning_vi: by + đại từ phản thân = một mình, tự mình.

words.def_en: My classmate and I don't talk to each other anymore. My mother and sister don't understand one another at all.
words.meaning_vi: each other / one another = hành động qua lại: A làm với B và B làm với A.

words.def_en: Dùng để…
Kể các hành động chính của câu chuyện, theo trình tự.
words.meaning_vi: This happened… we went to bed… I woke up… I saw… I screamed.

words.term: past continuous quá khứ tiếp diễn
words.def_en: Dựng bối cảnh và tả hành động đang diễn ra tại thời điểm đó.
words.meaning_vi: We were sleeping in my parents' bedroom. A figure was standing at the end of my bed.

words.term: past perfect past perfect continuous quá khứ hoàn thành
words.def_en: Nói về quá khứ xa hơn — việc xảy ra trước các sự kiện chính.
words.meaning_vi: My father had gone away on business. I had been reading a very scary story.

words.def_en: Ví dụ
words.meaning_vi: Quy tắc & giải thích tiếng Việt

words.def_en: My sister and I used to walk to the harbor every morning and watch the fishermen cleaning their nets. I used to have much longer hair when I was younger.
words.meaning_vi: used to + động từ nguyên mẫu = việc ta làm lặp đi lặp lại trong quá khứ, hoặc trạng thái đã thay đổi. "ngày trước hay…, ngày trước từng…"

words.def_en: Every night before we went to bed my mother would tell us a story, but she would never read them from a book — she would always make them up herself.
words.meaning_vi: would + động từ nguyên mẫu = cách nói thay thế used to cho hành động lặp lại. ⚠️ KHÔNG dùng would với động từ chỉ trạng thái: ❌ I would have much longer hair when I was younger.

words.def_en: When I was a teenager, my friends were always teasing me because of my red hair.
words.meaning_vi: always + quá khứ tiếp diễn cho việc lặp lại, nhất là thói quen gây khó chịu.

words.def_en: would

words.term: Hành động lặp lại (walk, tell, visit…)
Trạng thái đã thay đổi (have, be, like, live, know…)

words.def_en: Ví dụ
A: I really like your shirt. Doesn't Harry have one just like it? B: Speaking of Harry, did he get the job he applied for?
words.meaning_vi: Chuyển hướng cuộc trò chuyện nhưng vẫn bắt cầu từ điều vừa nói. "Nhắc mới nhớ, nói đến…"

words.def_en: So let's meet at five o'clock then. By the way / Incidentally, could you lend me some money until the weekend?
words.meaning_vi: Nêu điều vừa chợt nghĩ ra, hoặc đổi chủ đề hoàn toàn. "Mà này, tiện thể…" (Incidentally trang trọng hơn)

words.def_en: As I was saying, if Mark gets the job we'll have to reorganize the department.
words.meaning_vi: Quay lại chủ đề trước, thường sau khi bị ngắt lời. "Như tôi đang nói dở…"

words.term: As far as … is concerned, As regards …, Regarding …,
words.def_en: That's all you need to know about the travel arrangements. As far as accommodations are concerned, the options are living with a family or living in a dormitory.
words.meaning_vi: Giới thiệu một chủ đề mới hoặc báo hiệu chuyển mục. "Còn về vấn đề…" — rất hay dùng trong bài viết và thuyết trình.

words.def_en: We didn't go away for the weekend because I had too much work. In any case / Anyway the weather was awful, so we didn't miss anything.
words.meaning_vi: Báo rằng điều vừa nói ít quan trọng hơn điều sắp nói; hoặc quay lại chủ đề chính sau khi lạc đề. "Dù sao thì…"

words.term: Actually, In fact, As a matter of fact,
words.def_en: A: Did you see the game last night? B: No, I didn't. Actually / In fact / As a matter of fact I don't really like football.
words.meaning_vi: Nêu thông tin bổ sung gây bất ngờ hoặc trái với điều người kia tưởng. "Thật ra thì…"

words.def_en: I don't think I'll go to Nick's party. It will finish very late. Besides, I won't know many people there.
words.meaning_vi: Thêm lý do/thông tin nữa ủng hộ điều mình vừa nói. "Với lại, hơn nữa…"

words.def_en: I think we should buy them. After all, we'll never find them anywhere cheaper than this.
words.meaning_vi: Nêu lập luận mạnh mà người kia có thể chưa nghĩ tới. "Suy cho cùng thì…" — ⚠️ KHÔNG có nghĩa "sau cùng, cuối cùng"!

words.def_en: Yes, it was a bad accident. At least nobody was killed, though. Tom's coming to the meeting, or at least he said he was.
words.meaning_vi: (1) Nêu điểm tích cực sau tin xấu. "May mà…" (2) Làm điều vừa nói bớt chắc chắn. "ít nhất là…"

words.def_en: Basically, my job involves computer skills and people skills.
words.meaning_vi: Nêu điểm cốt lõi, quan trọng nhất. "Về cơ bản thì…"

words.def_en: Obviously, you can't get a real idea of life in Japan unless you can speak the language.
words.meaning_vi: Nêu một điều quá rõ ràng, ai cũng thấy. "Rõ ràng là…"

words.def_en: She's very selfish. I mean, she never thinks about other people at all.
words.meaning_vi: Giải thích rõ hơn, đưa thêm chi tiết. "Ý tôi là…"

words.def_en: A lot of people booed, and some people even left early. In other words, it was a complete disaster.
words.meaning_vi: Nói lại điều vừa nói theo cách khác, thường gọn và thẳng hơn. "Nói cách khác…"

words.def_en: The government is going to help first-time buyers. That is to say, they are going to make mortgages more easily available.
words.meaning_vi: Đưa giải thích/làm rõ cho điều vừa nói. "Tức là…" — trang trọng hơn in other words.

words.def_en: On the whole, I think that women make better journalists than men.
I like both condos, but all in all, I think I prefer the one next to the cathedral.
words.meaning_vi: Cho biết bạn đang cân nhắc tất cả mọi yếu tố. "Cân nhắc mọi mặt thì…"

words.def_en: Please try not to make a mess when you make the cake. Otherwise I'm going to have to clean the kitchen again.
words.meaning_vi: Nói hậu quả sẽ ra sao nếu điều kia không xảy ra. "Nếu không thì…, kẻo…"

words.term: On (the) one hand … On (the) other hand …
words.def_en: On the one hand, more young people today carry knives. On the other hand, the total number of violent crimes has dropped.
words.meaning_vi: Cân bằng hai luồng ý trái nhau. On the other hand cũng có thể đứng một mình để nêu ý ngược lại. "Một mặt… mặt khác…"

words.def_en: Ví dụ

words.level: must gần như chắc chắn CÓ
words.def_en: Dia must be very well off — she has an enormous house. You must have seen him — he was standing right in front of you!
words.meaning_vi: must + nguyên mẫu → suy luận về hiện tại. must have + V-ed → suy luận về quá khứ. "chắc chắn là…, hẳn là…"

words.level: can't / couldn't gần như chắc chắn KHÔNG
words.def_en: They can't be playing very well — they're losing 3-0. You can't / couldn't have spent very long on this essay — you've only written 100 words.
words.meaning_vi: ⚠️ Phải dùng can't, KHÔNG dùng mustn't: ❌ She mustn't be at home. ✅ She can't be at home. "không thể nào…"

words.def_en: I haven't seen the sales manager today. He may / might / could be off sick. Do you think someone may / might / could have taken them? He may / might not have heard the message.
words.meaning_vi: Nói rằng điều đó có khả năng đúng. "có thể là…"

words.def_en: If I mail the letter today, it should arrive on Friday. I mailed the letter a week ago. It should have arrived by now.
words.meaning_vi: Mô tả tình huống mà ta mong đợi sẽ xảy ra (hoặc lẽ ra đã xảy ra). "đáng lẽ / chắc là sẽ…"

words.def_en: Ví dụ
Not only is my brother lazy, (but) he's also very selfish.
Not until you can behave like an adult will we treat you like an adult.
Never have I heard such a ridiculous argument.
No sooner had the football game started than it began to snow heavily.
words.meaning_vi: = cách nói trang trọng của as soon as. ⚠️ Đi với than, không phải when. "Vừa mới… thì…"

words.def_en: The train began to move. Only then was I able to relax. Only when you leave home do you realize how expensive everything is.
Hardly had I sat down when the train began to move.
words.meaning_vi: ⚠️ Đi với when, không phải than. "Vừa mới… thì…"

words.def_en: Rarely have I met a more irritating person.
Ví dụ
words.meaning_vi: Quy tắc & giải thích tiếng Việt

words.def_en: It seems / appears (that) there is a direct relationship between your position in the family and your personality. The new manager seems / appears to be very friendly. Excuse me. There seems to be a mistake with the bill.
words.meaning_vi: Hai mẫu: ① It seems / appears + (that) + mệnh đề ② Chủ ngữ + seem / appear + to + V "có vẻ như…, dường như…" 💡 Câu thứ ba là cách phàn nàn lịch sự rất hay: thay vì "You made a mistake" thì nói "There seems to be a mistake".

words.def_en: It would seem / appear (that) Mr. Hill had been using the company's assets to pay off his private debts.
words.meaning_vi: Thêm would để giữ khoảng cách xa hơn nữa, nghe càng ít chắc chắn. Trang trọng hơn It seems… — hay gặp trong báo cáo, tin tức.

words.level: There + động từ bị động + to + nguyên mẫu
words.def_en: There are thought to be over a thousand species in danger of extinction.
words.meaning_vi: Dùng khi câu gốc bắt đầu bằng there is/are.

words.def_en: Ví dụ
It's a difficult problem. I wish I knew the answer to it!
words.meaning_vi: Ước điều gì đó khác đi ở hiện tại/tương lai (nhưng không thể). "Giá mà tôi biết…"

words.def_en: I wish I hadn't spoken to Jane like that — you know how sensitive she is.
words.meaning_vi: Hối tiếc về chuyện đã (hoặc đã không) xảy ra trong quá khứ. "Giá mà tôi đã không…"

words.term: If only + quá khứ đơn / quá khứ hoàn thành
words.def_en: If only I knew the answer! If only you hadn't forgotten the map, we'd be there by now.
words.meaning_vi: Y hệt wish nhưng nhấn mạnh hơn. Có thể đứng một mình hoặc kèm mệnh đề thứ hai.

words.term: wish / If only + người/vật + would + V
words.def_en: I wish the bus would come! If only he wouldn't keep whistling when I'm working!
words.meaning_vi: Muốn điều gì xảy ra hoặc ngừng xảy ra vì nó làm ta khó chịu. ⚠️ Không dùng would cho chính mình: ❌ I wish I would be taller. → ✅ I wish I were taller.

words.term: would rather + chủ ngữ khác + thì quá khứ
words.def_en: I'd rather you left your dog outside — I'm allergic to animals. Are you sure this is a good time to talk? Would you rather I called back later?
words.meaning_vi: Khi đổi chủ ngữ → bắt buộc dùng thì quá khứ. ❌ I'd rather you not talk about it. ✅ I'd rather you didn't talk about it.

words.term: would rather + nguyên mẫu không to
words.def_en: I'd rather not talk about it.
words.meaning_vi: Khi không đổi chủ ngữ (cùng là "tôi").

words.term: It's time + chủ ngữ + quá khứ đơn
words.def_en: Don't you think it's time you found a job? It's been six months since you finished college! It's time the government did something about unemployment.
words.meaning_vi: Nói rằng việc đó phải làm ngay bây giờ hoặc rất sớm — thường mang sắc thái trách móc, sốt ruột.

words.def_en: It's time to go now.
words.meaning_vi: Dùng khi không cần nêu rõ ai.

words.term: It's high time + quá khứ đơn
words.def_en: It's high time you started taking this seriously.
words.meaning_vi: Thêm high để nhấn mạnh hơn nữa.

words.def_en: Ví dụ
words.meaning_vi: Danh sách động từ & ghi chú

words.def_en: We expect the flight to arrive at 7:50. It took me forever to get there. She advised him not to travel by train.
words.meaning_vi: ask · advise · allow · beg · cause · enable · encourage · expect · force · intend · invite · mean · order · persuade · remind · take (time) · teach · tell · warn 💡 Sau advise, persuade, remind, teach, tell, warn còn có thể dùng tân ngữ + mệnh đề that: The airline advises that you carry your passport at all times.

words.def_en: I want you to call the airline. I'd like you to send me the bill.
words.meaning_vi: want · would like · would prefer ⚠️ Sau các động từ này KHÔNG dùng mệnh đề that: ❌ I would like that you think about it. ✅ I would like you to think about it.

words.def_en: I'm waiting for my friend to arrive. We've arranged for a taxi to come at 6:30.
words.meaning_vi: Một số động từ cần thêm for ngay sau động từ, trước tân ngữ: love · hate · arrange · ask · plan · wait

words.def_en: Ví dụ
Please let me explain! He made me feel really guilty. Can you help me do the dishes?
words.meaning_vi: ⚠️ Khi make chuyển sang bị động thì lại có to: We were made to clean our rooms every morning. 💡 help cũng dùng được với to: help me to do.

words.def_en: Ví dụ

words.level: If + thì hiện tại bất kỳ, … dạng tương lai bất kỳ
words.def_en: They won't get a table unless they've already made a reservation. Can I borrow your dictionary if you're not using it? If it stops raining, I'm going to walk into town.
words.meaning_vi: Tình huống có thể xảy ra ở hiện tại/tương lai và kết quả của nó.

words.level: If + quá khứ (đơn/tiếp diễn), … would / could / might + V
words.def_en: How would you know if he wasn't telling the truth? If we had a little more time here, we could go on an all-day river trip.
words.meaning_vi: Tình huống giả định / khó xảy ra ở hiện tại hoặc tương lai.

words.level: If + quá khứ hoàn thành, … would/could/might have + V-ed
words.def_en: I would have picked you up if I had known what time your flight arrived. If I'd been looking where I was going, I would've seen the hole in the road.
words.meaning_vi: Tình huống giả định trong quá khứ — chuyện đã không xảy ra như vậy.

words.term: I wouldn't be in this mess if I had listened to your advice.
words.meaning_vi: Kết quả ở hiện tại (type 2) ← điều kiện ở quá khứ (type 3). "Giờ tôi đã không rơi vào mớ bòng bong này nếu hồi đó tôi nghe lời anh."

words.def_en: Ví dụ

words.level: as long as / so long as provided / providing (that) on the condition (that)
words.def_en: I'll tell you what happened as long as you promise not to tell anyone else. Provided (that) the bank lends us all the money we need, we're going to buy that condo. They agreed to lend us the car on the condition (that) we returned it by the weekend.
words.meaning_vi: "miễn là, với điều kiện là" — nhấn mạnh điều kiện bắt buộc.

words.def_en: I'm going to sell the car whether you agree with me or not.
words.meaning_vi: "dù … hay không" — kết quả không đổi.

words.def_en: Even if I get the job, I'm going to continue living with my parents for a while.
Suppose you lost your job, what would you do?
words.meaning_vi: "giả sử như…" — hay dùng để đặt câu hỏi giả định.

words.level: Had + S + V-ed (đảo ngữ, trang trọng)
words.def_en: Had I known that you were coming, I would have bought some coffee. Had the rebels not surrendered, there would have been more casualties.
words.meaning_vi: = If I had known… Bỏ if, đảo had lên đầu. Phủ định đặt not sau chủ ngữ.

words.def_en: Ví dụ
I heard the girl play a piece by Chopin. I saw the man hit his dog.
words.meaning_vi: Bạn nghe/thấy TRỌN VẸN hành động từ đầu đến cuối.

words.def_en: I heard the girl playing a piece by Chopin. I saw the man hitting his dog.
words.meaning_vi: Bạn nghe/thấy hành động ĐANG DIỄN RA, hoặc hành động lặp lại.

words.def_en: Ví dụ
You look tired. That smells delicious. This music sounds awful. These shoes feel uncomfortable. The soup tastes a little salty.
words.meaning_vi: ⚠️ Dùng tính từ, không phải trạng từ.

words.def_en: You look like your mother. It sounds like thunder. This tastes like tea, not coffee.
words.meaning_vi: Sau like phải là danh từ.

words.level: as if / as though + mệnh đề
words.def_en: She looked as if / as though she had been crying.
words.meaning_vi: Sau as if / as though là cả mệnh đề (S + V).

words.def_en: This smells / tastes of garlic. This smells / tastes like garlic.
words.meaning_vi: ⚠️ Khác nhau quan trọng: of = thực sự CÓ mùi/vị đó. like = giống mùi/vị đó, nhưng có lẽ không phải.

words.def_en: Ví dụ

words.level: BỊ ĐỘNG being done to be done
words.def_en: She loves being told how pretty she is. I'm tired of being lied to. I want the truth. It's very difficult to get promoted in this company. My car needs to be serviced.
words.meaning_vi: Hành động được/bị làm lên chủ ngữ, chứ không phải chủ ngữ tự làm.

words.level: HOÀN THÀNH having done to have done
words.def_en: He thanked them for having helped him. Having studied one language before makes it easier to learn another. How wonderful to have finished all our tests! By the time I'm 30, I hope to have started a family.
words.meaning_vi: Nhấn mạnh hành động đã hoàn tất hoặc thuộc quá khứ. 💡 Nhiều khi không khác gì dạng đơn: He denied stealing / having stolen the money.

words.level: to have done sau would like/love/hate/prefer/rather
words.def_en: I would like to have seen your face when they told you you won the competition! We would rather have stayed in a more central hotel, but they were all full.
words.meaning_vi: Nói về việc đã không xảy ra mà ta tiếc. So sánh: I would like to visit Bali. (sắp tới sẽ đi) I would like to have visited Bali. (hồi đó ở Indonesia mà không đi được)

words.def_en: I'd like to be lying on the beach right now. She seems to be coughing a lot — do you think she's OK?
words.meaning_vi: Hành động đang diễn ra quanh thời điểm ta đang nói.

words.def_en: I don't know where to go or what to do.
words.meaning_vi: ⚠️ Trừ why: ❌ I don't know why to go.

words.level: So sánh nhất / first, last… + to + V
words.def_en: He's the youngest player ever to play for Peru. Who was the first person to walk on the moon?
Ví dụ
He got up and (he) took a shower. She came to the meeting but (she) didn't say anything. We should call him or (we should) send him an email. We usually have dinner at 10:00, and then (we) watch TV.
words.meaning_vi: ✅ Sau and · but · or (và cả then) ta thường bỏ chủ ngữ lặp lại, hoặc bỏ cả chủ ngữ + trợ động từ — nhất là khi các mệnh đề ngắn.

words.def_en: They locked the door and windows before they left. Why don't we look at the photos after we finish dinner. He's stressed because he has too much work. She was horrified when she saw the mess he had left. I met Sam while I was working in Italy.
words.meaning_vi: ❌ KHÔNG được bỏ chủ ngữ sau before · after · because · when · while. ❌ They locked the door before left.

words.def_en: I haven't been to Egypt, but I'd love to. (to go) The students cheated on the exam, even though I told them not to.
words.meaning_vi: Reduced infinitive: giữ lại mỗi chữ to, bỏ động từ theo sau.

words.def_en: A person who studies family history.
A diagram showing the relationships between family members over generations.
An island in New York Bay that was a US immigration station from 1892 to 1954, holding records of millions of immigrants.
words.meaning_vi: Đảo Ellis — trạm nhập cư Mỹ

words.def_en: Protection a government gives to people who have left their own country, usually because they were in danger for political reasons.
A place where people forced to leave their country live temporarily in tents or temporary buildings.
A place or situation in which large numbers of people, ideas, etc. are mixed together.
Something that blocks your progress.
An online forum where people post questions and answers.
A person who writes scripts for films or TV.
A movie set during the life of a particular person or in the history of a particular country.
Something in a book or film that is very obviously placed in the wrong period of history.
words.meaning_vi: Chi tiết lạc thời đại rành rành

words.def_en: A political institution in ancient Rome.
Clothing worn by the citizens of ancient Rome.
(old-fashioned) To treat something in a way that shows you feel no responsibility or respect for it.
The version accepted by most people as being correct.
words.meaning_vi: Bản được số đông mặc nhiên coi là đúng

words.def_en: Extremely full.
To consider something carefully before deciding.
To accidentally reveal something you wanted to hide.
To have meaning or importance for someone.
To be completely aware of something.
The practice of lending very small amounts of money to poor people to start a business.
Not existing to make money.
Earning very little money.
Things of value that a person or company owns.
Violence between members of a family.
A very large amount of something.
To be recognized as the person who did something first.
A structure that rewards people for doing something.
Painting outdoors, directly from the subject. (gốc Pháp)
A view or painting of a city.
A view or painting of the countryside.
A painting of objects such as fruit or flowers.
A painting or photograph of a person.
Having learned something without a teacher.
A show of work by one artist only.
Artworks a museum owns and keeps on show.
The way the parts of a picture are arranged.
Something not yet finished.
Not moving or changing.
Something that takes your attention away.
Relating to cooking.
The second most senior chef in a kitchen. (gốc Pháp)
An experienced person who advises and trains someone.
A prize or award that pays for training or education.
words.meaning_vi: Học bổng, giải thưởng đào tạo

words.def_en: Having won a prize.
A person who applies for a job or place.
Someone who wants everything to be exactly right.
The ability to make good commercial decisions.
The series of jobs leading through a career.
